exec: pm.test('Deleted note absent, initial note retained',()=>{const rows=pm.response.json().data;pm.expect(rows.some(n=>n.id===pm.collectionVariables.get('noteId'))).to.equal(false);pm.expect(rows.some(n=>n.text==='Synthetic initial note')).to.equal(true);});

item.name: C1-10 Read note edit and deletion audit history

exec: pm.test('Original and previous versions retained',()=>{const h=pm.response.json().data;pm.expect(h.some(e=>e.eventType==='note'&&e.text==='Synthetic Postman handover')).to.equal(true);pm.expect(h.some(e=>e.eventType==='note_edited'&&e.previousText==='Synthetic Postman handover')).to.equal(true);pm.expect(h.some(e=>e.eventType==='note_deleted'&&e.previousText==='Synthetic edited handover')).to.equal(true);});
pm.test('Reopening starts a new unacknowledged assignment',()=>{const d=pm.response.json().data;pm.expect(d.assignmentGeneration).to.eql(1);pm.expect(d.acknowledgedAt).to.eql(null);});

const h=pm.response.json().data;pm.test('Transitions and note retained',()=>{for(const e of ['created','accepted','completed','reopened','acknowledged','note','edited'])pm.expect(h.some(x=>x.eventType===e)).to.eql(true);});
pm.test('No false delivery or app acknowledgement',()=>{const j=pm.response.json().data;pm.expect(j.length).to.eql(2);pm.expect(j.every(x=>x.status==='disabled'&&x.attemptCount===0)).to.eql(true);});
